We live in the fallen world, but O Christians, take heart, because our King's reign has begun.
Let's pray together.
Heavenly Father, we are those who formerly were rebels, for we deserved only to be crushed
by Your justice.
But Lord, You have sent Your Son to die for us, to receive the punishment that we deserve,
And now you have made us your servants, your children.
O God, we give you great thanks for you are a merciful God.
Lord, help us this week to be faithful servants, faithful ambassadors of Jesus Christ.
And we would tell many around us about what He has done and about His reign that will
soon come.
We pray this in His name, Amen.
